scope: Historical pilot projection of C1 only. The full record contains additional findings. The current article is revised, so this historical finding is stale.

findings.title: The article reverses the task dependencies and invents a blanket T1 gate
findings.location: source lines 16, 47, 85 and 93. Quotes include "none of them touched T1–T7 gate conditions", "T2–T7 are downstream of T1", and "Not actionable until T1 opens".
findings.explanation: the merged [roadmap task table](https://github.com/ojfbot/morning-cockpit/blob/ad7f5376904419c678fe3fbfa1cd677e878cf5b4/.claude/roadmap.md#L341) explicitly gives T1 a dependency on T2 fixtures, leaves Q2 open during comparison, and assigns different entrances to T4–T7. The [transition plan](https://github.com/ojfbot/morning-cockpit/blob/ad7f5376904419c678fe3fbfa1cd677e878cf5b4/planning/mc-ux-01/transition-plan.md#L72) also puts T2 before T1. [Issue #55's completion receipt](https://github.com/ojfbot/morning-cockpit/issues/55#issuecomment-6100803626) confirms that the review amendment corrected the qualified task crosswalk. [PR #56's pinned validation record](https://github.com/ojfbot/morning-cockpit/blob/b18493480c4eb29f4e2348a12bca4f02f1440fd2/verification/mc-ux-01-evidence-inspector-2026-10-10.md#L6) documents an already implemented bounded T2/T3 slice. Its [retained owner gate](https://github.com/ojfbot/morning-cockpit/blob/b18493480c4eb29f4e2348a12bca4f02f1440fd2/decisions/open-unknowns.md#L1) concerns the public REST diagnostic contract.
findings.correction: distinguish blocked roadmap planning entries from the existing draft implementation. State that #56 implements the bounded T2/T3 slice and awaits dedicated contract review and explicit owner approval before merge. Preserve the separate shell, correspondence and runtime gates. Remove the five-decisions-before-T1 prerequisite and blanket downstream ordering. Describe the review amendment as correcting gate attribution, rather than leaving it untouched. Do not infer an automated dispatch receipt from the existence of implementation.
